scope: Bounded independent textual/primary-source review; not browser or PDF visual QA

profiles.title: Pembrolizumab + carboplatin + fluorouracil
profiles.evidence_population: Untreated locally incurable recurrent or metastatic HNSCC; study analyses included different PD-L1 CPS groups.

profiles.title: Cisplatin every 3 weeks + head and neck radiotherapy
profiles.evidence_population: RTOG 91-11: selected stage III/IV glottic or supraglottic squamous cell cancer of the larynx; not the entire NCCP head and neck population.

profiles.title: Pembrolizumab + cisplatin + fluorouracil
profiles.evidence_population: Untreated locally incurable recurrent or metastatic HNSCC; study analyses included different PD-L1 CPS groups.

profiles.title: Weekly cisplatin + nasopharyngeal radiotherapy
profiles.evidence_population: Chemoradiation for locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

profiles.title: Weekly cisplatin + head and neck radiotherapy
profiles.evidence_population: Small historical phase I/II cohorts with locally advanced inoperable or unresectable head and neck cancer; separate JCOG1008 high-risk postoperative population.

profiles.title: Weekly cetuximab + head and neck radiotherapy
profiles.evidence_population: Locoregionally advanced squamous head and neck cancer in the original trial.
